system.description:
Reflex Amp

Your movement speed is increased by +10.

You gain a Rank of Mastery to Dexterity based checks.

You gain a +1 bonus to your Dexterity saving throws and your AC.
system.summary: +10 speed, Mastery on Dexterity checks, and +1 to Dexterity saves and AC. Lasts 1 minute.

rules.text: Start: a Bonus action on your turn, or when you cast a jutsu granted by Mobile Savant.
Ends early with Speed Blitz (an attack with Jack of All: Combat that can't be reacted to) or Burst Rush (Dash as a teleport, bringing an adjacent willing ally).
